job.title: Job Application for Principal SAP Retail POS Consultant at C5MI Insight

tailoring.headline: Principal SAP Commerce Consultant | SAP Certified | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant and Senior Java Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Extensive hands-on delivery across SAP Commerce, OCC REST APIs, promotions, pricing and data integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Strong background in requirements analysis, user stories, agile delivery and SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer expertise.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Principal SAP Retail POS Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am very excited to apply for the Principal SAP Retail POS Consultant position at C5Miinsightllc, bringing over 5 years of specialized experience building and delivering enterprise-scale SAP Commerce platforms for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell. As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, I offer deep technical and functional expertise across commerce architecture, integrations, and promotions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Pricing Delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Promotions & Omnichannel Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Hybris modules including the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), and custom OCC REST Web Services for omnichannel storefront consumers.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and technical execution by analysing processes, writing user stories, and translating complex stakeholder needs into robust SAP solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered complex PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved integration bottlenecks between ERP, MDM and commerce platforms across international teams.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I look forward to discussing how my SAP expertise can drive value for C5Miinsightllc.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise to C5Miinsightllc to help design and implement robust enterprise platforms. Your focus on advanced commerce and omnichannel solutions aligns perfectly with my background in delivering scalable architectures, pricing and promotion engines, and seamless ERP and PIM integrations for global organizations.
tailoring.motivation_short: SAP Certified Commerce Developer with 5+ years building enterprise SAP Commerce platforms, REST APIs, pricing engines, and robust business integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I am very interested in the Principal SAP Retail POS Consultant role at C5Miinsightllc. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce experience and SAP certification, I bring strong techno-functional delivery skills. I am based in Germany with a valid work permit. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Principal SAP Retail POS Consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Principal SAP Retail POS Consultant role at C5Miinsightllc. With over 5 years of professional experience as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in SAP Commerce, pricing, promotions, and enterprise integrations.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
